'''Veek''', also known by the nickname '''Veek the Sneak''', was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] leader of [[Harido Wald]], a smuggling ring operating in [[Mek-Sha]] during the [[third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Biography==
During [[Huttbreaker's Rebellion]], Veek acquired and smuggled in the weapons used by the oppressed workers of Mek-Sha to overthrow their [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] masters.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Veek the Sneak}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Veek was an ambitious individual and sought to expand the Harido Wald's reach and influence. Veek liked to conduct business in a friendly manner. Additionally, Veek liked decorating his office with gifts from satisfied customers who were happy that the merchandise Veek delivered to them came without violence or posturing involved.<ref name="TORC" />
